> Hi Samira — thanks for the note and the questionnaire...

Quick technical note from our side:
- We can provide a 540-day retention for the event/audit logs you called out via a tiered storage approach. The first 90 days remain hot for queries; days 91–540 move to a compressed cold tier with retrieval within 6–12 hours.
- For the attestation export, we estimate ~1.8 TB outbound for the common audit slices (headers + transaction metadata) for the window you described. If you need immediate hot exports with sub-hour SLAs, we recommend a temporary Dedicated capacity add-on for the 7–10 day window.
- Evidence manifest (attached) will map each control to a storage path and retention policy. Please confirm which controls require immutable snapshots vs. standard snapshot + checksum.

Open items for Samira:
1) Confirm immutable snapshot requirement for controls: YES / NO / PARTIAL (list controls).
2) Confirm preferred export SLA (standard 6–12h vs. expedited <1h).
3) Confirm Wed 09:30 PST call.

Thanks,
